name: Command / Documentation Search
description: Documentation Search product scenario for the Command component.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Commands and labelled groups in list order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: search
controls.description: Search text that filters the items; the parent owns it while set.

controls.name: defaultSearch
controls.description: Search text on mount when `search` is not set; read once.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.description: Hint in the empty search field and the dialog trigger; names the search without aria-label.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: Where the search shows: in the page, or in a dialog opened from a trigger; auto is a dialog below 900px. Default auto.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled visibility of the dialog; an inline Command is always shown.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Dialog visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the search field, its list and dialog, and the dialog trigger.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of the elements that name the search field, its list and dialog, and the trigger; wins over aria-label.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Command renders itself: `empty` replaces the list when no item matches.
